    spectra:reasonForChange """Fist of all, there is no need to transfer the last Target NG-RAN node UE XnAP IDs of all candidate cells from the source gNB to the new serving gNBs after fast LTM recovery. As the UE can only do the fast LTM recovery in a candidate cell in the target gNB, in which case, the proceeding CELL SWITCH NOTIFICATION message already contains the last Target NG-RAN node UE XnAP IDs.
On the other hand, after LTM cell switch, the new serving gNB needs to send the per node level old target UE XnAP ID to each candidate gNB to enable the candidate gNB to identify the UE and retrieve the UE context.""" ;
    spectra:summaryOfChange """The following change is made to the XnAP for inter-CU LTM.
Add semantic description for the per cell level Last Target NG-RAN node UE XnAP ID IE in the LTM CONFIGURATION UPDATE message, saying that the ID is included once for each candidate gNB.

Impact Analysis:
This CR has an impact under protocol and functional point of view. 
The impact can be considered isolated.""" ;
    spectra:tdocNumber "R3-260688" .

On the other hand, after LTM cell switch, the new serving gNB needs to send the per node level old target UE XnAP ID to each candidate gNB to enable the candidate gNB to identify the UE and retrieve the UE context.
